chapter: Royal Roost, Birdland and Three O'Clock High
title: Harry Belafonte as house singer at the Royal Roost
summary: Belafonte then sang like Billy Eckstine and the guys put him down; later he told Collins on Nat Cole's show that he had made it.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I think we were saying this last record was "Focus," and "John's Delight." Right? Are we on the air? Yeah. But this was during the time I worked with Tad, at the Royal Roost. The house singer at that time was Harry Belafonte. And he --

That's right, that's right. And he was trying to sing like Billy Eckstine at that time, you know, and all the guys would just put him down, you know. But I never did. This is a funny thing, I never did. But when I joined Nat, and Nat had his show, Harry was a guest one day and -- on one of these particular shows and he came up and sat by me during one of the breaks and said, John,
you never thought I'd make it, did you. I said, I never doubted that you'd make it, Harry. He said, Buddy, here I am.
